findings.summary: The Save precondition now requires a nonblank birthday, but the birthday is described as optional everywhere else.
findings.evidence: preconditions: [Owner session, Nonblank name, Nonblank birthday] vs. description: Optional birthday as month and day; C.webapp.contact.save: "an optional month-day birthday"

findings.summary: The birthday field has cardinality 'exactly one' while its description and the dialog description call it optional, unlike the sibling ChannelFields, which uses 'optional'.
findings.evidence: cardinality: exactly one / description: Optional birthday as month and day

findings.summary: The birthday attribute is typed local-date, which requires a year, but the field allows the year to be left blank and the criterion validates a month-day value.
findings.evidence: { name: birthday, type: local-date, optional: true } vs. "the year may be left blank" and "optional month-day birthday"
